sheet: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one wide horizontal 16:9 photographic facial-angle reference sheet of the single fictional adult Korean person Claire. Image 1 is the sole authoritative face, wardrobe, age impression and hair reference. Three equal-width columns from one coordinated studio shoot. LEFT COLUMN: head and shoulders turned roughly 45 degrees toward frame-left, both eyes still visible but left pose unmistakable. MIDDLE COLUMN: straight frontal view like image 1, the same face and both eyes visible looking at the camera. RIGHT COLUMN: head and shoulders turned roughly 45 degrees toward frame-right, not digitally mirrored, both eyes still visible, correct anatomy and asymmetry. In each column the crop starts above the crown and includes the entire neck, both shoulders until cropped by the panel edges, the same low-tied almost black ponytail and straight fringe, small gold hoop earrings, slate-blue cotton button shirt, matte gray wall. Preserve Claire's almond eye shape, naturally asymmetric subtle facial details, nose bridge, mouth corner shape, rounded jaw, natural skin and apparent adult age. Keep head width and eye level consistent across columns, quiet closed lips and neutral expression, eyes follow the nose direction in each image, with the same diffuse frontal lighting and no beauty curves, no high-contrast side light. Make genuine opposite viewpoints of one face. No words, labels, borders, watermark or graphic marks.
